article_title: Some under-25s should get fewer benefits, Milburn review to say

tasks.prompt: What major change is Alan Milburn's review expected to recommend?
options: Replacing all UK benefits with private insurance
Moving many under-25s off the main sickness and disability benefits while expanding employment support
Ending employment programmes for young people
Raising Personal Independence Payment for every claimant
tasks.correct_answer: Moving many under-25s off the main sickness and disability benefits while expanding employment support
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הסקירה צפויה להציע צמצום גישה של צעירים לקצבאות המרכזיות לצד השקעה נרחבת בתמיכה תעסוקתית.

tasks.prompt: What would most affected under-25s receive instead of the health element of Universal Credit or Pip?
options: A pension at the higher disability rate
A one-off education grant
An allowance at the same basic rate as Universal Credit
No financial support of any kind
tasks.correct_answer: An allowance at the same basic rate as Universal Credit
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי התוכנית, צעירים יקבלו קצבה בגובה השיעור הבסיסי של Universal Credit, וחלקם יוכלו לקבל תוספת עלויות.

tasks.prompt: What did Milburn's interim report say about young disability or health-benefit claimants?
options: 19% of them were in work
Half of them were over 25
All of them were out of education
Only 3% received Pip
tasks.explanation_hebrew: נתוני הסקר בדוח הביניים מצאו כי 19% מהצעירים שקיבלו קצבאות בריאות או נכות עבדו.

tasks.prompt: In this report, what does “a carrot and stick” approach mean?
options: Funding food rather than transport
Combining incentives and support with possible penalties for non-participation
Giving every claimant the same unconditional payment
Separating benefits from employment policy entirely
tasks.correct_answer: Combining incentives and support with possible penalties for non-participation
tasks.explanation_hebrew: carrot and stick מתאר שילוב של עידוד ותמיכה עם סנקציה אפשרית אם צעירים לא ישתפו פעולה עם מסלולי התעסוקה.

tasks.prompt: Which additional costs did student Tom Ashforth say Pip helps him cover?
options: Private school fees and a car loan
Rent on a second home
Prescriptions, mobility aids and accessible learning resources
Travel to overseas work placements
tasks.correct_answer: Prescriptions, mobility aids and accessible learning resources
tasks.explanation_hebrew: טום הסביר שהקצבה מסייעת בהוצאות הנובעות מלקות הראייה שלו, ובהן מרשמים, עזרי ניידות וחומרי לימוד נגישים.

tasks.prompt: What does Dame Meg Hillier mean by giving Milburn “a fair wind”?
options: She is offering cautious support and a chance for his proposals to be heard
She wants the review delayed because of bad weather
She rejects every proposed welfare change
She will support only environmental spending
tasks.correct_answer: She is offering cautious support and a chance for his proposals to be heard
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי a fair wind כאן מציין יחס אוהד או הזדמנות הוגנת להתקדם, אף שאין זו התחייבות מלאה לתמוך בכל פרט.

tasks.prompt: Why could the proposals cost money before they produce savings?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את ההשקעה הראשונית ואת פרק הזמן הארוך עד לחיסכון תקציבי.
expected_points: The plan includes billions of pounds for employment support
It proposes work placements, job subsidies and personal advisers
A new welfare structure would need to be built largely from scratch
Milburn said monetary savings might take almost a decade to appear

tasks.prompt: Summarise the main arguments for and against applying the proposed benefit changes to under-25s.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג את טיעון סיכויי החיים והתעסוקה מול החששות מהוצאות נכות ומהכללה לפי גיל.
expected_points: Milburn argues the current system prioritises short-term finances over long-term life chances
The government promises earlier employment support for young people
Supporters see an integrated package rather than an unexplained cut
Critics say disability-related costs do not disappear when access to Pip is restricted
Tom Ashforth argues individual need should be assessed case by case rather than by age
Some Labour MPs are reluctant to reduce existing claimants' entitlements

tasks.prompt: Why might Labour MPs respond differently to these proposals than to the previous year's welfare reforms?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשוות בין קיצוץ לא מוסבר בעבר לבין החבילה הנוכחית של תמיכה, מחקר ופרטים עתידיים.
expected_points: Last year's proposal was perceived as a cut without a clear account of what would happen to claimants
Milburn conducted a year-long review and is proposing extensive employment support
Some MPs regard his work as substantive enough to consider fairly
Uncertainty remains, especially about cuts for existing claimants

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced paragraph evaluating whether age should determine access to disability benefits, using evidence from the report.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג טיעון מכל צד, להשתמש בעובדות מהכתבה ולסיים בהערכה מנומקת.
expected_points: The review aims to reduce the nearly one million young people not in education, employment or training
Employment support may improve long-term opportunities for some claimants
Pip covers additional disability costs and is available to people both in and out of work
Tom Ashforth's examples show that young claimants can have essential age-independent expenses
A balanced conclusion may favour individual assessment, safeguards for severe disability and transparent support obligations
